summary: All rounding moved into meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed), the decimal-context line removed, and tests added in tests/test_money.py. Batch worker threads never had the half-up context, so batch keeps rounding context-dependent sites half-even via keyword-only `method` parameters; unchanged oddities: negative zeros survive in most amounts, and results beyond 28 significant digits (implicit decimal arithmetic precision) were not specially emulated.
